scope.summary: needs_update. Both changed print depth guards are supported behaviors that the old read target cannot reach. The supplied build recipe and defaults establish a nesting limit of 1000.

assessments.reason: A constructed chain of 1001 arrays reaches the new print_array rejection at depth 1000. The entry prints only a parsed tree, while parse_array rejects the 1001st array.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects an array at the same nesting limit.
Array nodes can be attached without a depth restriction.

assessments.reason: A constructed chain of 1001 objects reaches the new print_object rejection at depth 1000. The entry prints only a parsed tree, while parse_object rejects the 1001st object.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects an object at the same nesting limit.
Named child objects can be attached without a depth restriction.

build.reason: The delegated recipe builds static cjson from cJSON.c and links the read target. The supplied configuration contains no nesting limit override, so the header default applies. This is a static recipe assessment, not a claimed build result.

evidence.dependency_reason: The delegated recipe selects the static library and links the fuzz entry.
The complete CMake recipe defines the static cjson target and contains no nesting limit override.
The header supplies the default limit of 1000.

input.reason: Valid flag bytes and a trailing NUL admit JSON text to ParseWithOpts; the termination flag is passed through. Valid shallow arrays and objects can be parsed.

evidence.dependency_reason: ParseWithOpts measures the NUL-terminated text and delegates with the termination flag.
The delegated parser accepts a successfully parsed value and applies the optional termination check.
Array and object text dispatch to their parsers.

lifecycle.reason: With the default allocation hooks, the entry frees a returned print buffer, frees its optional text copy, and deletes the parsed tree. The print helpers release their buffers on failure.

evidence.dependency_reason: Default hooks use the standard allocator family.
Unbuffered printing releases its buffer on failure.
Buffered printing releases its buffer on failure.
Deleting the root recursively releases parsed children and their allocations.

control_flow.reason: Successful shallow array and object parses reach the selected print variant and dispatch to the corresponding changed function. The unreachable depth-1000 behaviors are assessed under their change IDs.

evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing dispatches array and object input.
Printing dispatches parsed arrays and objects to the changed functions.

blockers.requirement: Make printing a constructible array tree at depth 1000 reachable by the read target.
blockers.target_route: Valid four-byte flags and NUL-terminated JSON → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → selected print variant → print_value → print_array.
blockers.failure_condition: Construct 1001 arrays and attach each as the previous array's child. Printing the root reaches the new depth-1000 rejection, but the target's parser rejects the 1001st array and returns NULL before any print call.
blockers.alternative_paths: All three print choices receive the same parsed tree. The entry never constructs a deeper tree; its optional minify call edits a separate text copy after printing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The effective recipe uses the header default limit of 1000.
The public constructor creates each array node.
The add operation attaches the nodes without a depth check.
Parsing rejects the 1001st array at depth 1000.
Print dispatch sends arrays to print_array.
The build recipe supplies no limit override.

blockers.requirement: Make printing a constructible object tree at depth 1000 reachable by the read target.
blockers.target_route: Valid four-byte flags and NUL-terminated JSON → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → selected print variant → print_value → print_object.
blockers.failure_condition: Construct 1001 objects with named child links. Printing the root reaches the new depth-1000 rejection, but the target's parser rejects the 1001st object and returns NULL before any print call.
blockers.alternative_paths: All three print choices receive the same parsed tree. Flag choices and trailing text cannot deepen it; optional minify edits a separate text copy after printing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The effective recipe uses the header default limit of 1000.
The public constructor creates each object node.
The add operation attaches named child objects without a depth check.
Parsing rejects the 1001st object at depth 1000.
Print dispatch sends objects to print_object.
The build recipe supplies no limit override.
